name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2026-01-16, at wavelengths from 0.81 to 4.32 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
